clips.hook: A glitch saved Grand Theft Auto
clips.title: How a bug saved GTA and led to GTA 6
clips.caption: GTA was nearly cancelled in 1995. Then a bug made the police ram you off the road, and that accident became the sandbox every GTA is built on. 30 years later, GTA 6. Clip: Mrwhosetheboss. #GTA6 #GTA #RockstarGames #gamedev #retrogaming

clips.title: The GTA bug that created the wanted system
clips.caption: GTA's cops were coded to pull you over. A route-finding bug made them ram you instead, and that mistake became the wanted system and the whole sandbox idea. Clip: Mrwhosetheboss. #GTA #gamedev #Rockstar #GTA6 #gaminghistory

clips.title: How GTA 3 fit a whole city in 32MB
clips.caption: The PS2 had 32MB of memory. Liberty City in 3D needed about 100. Rockstar loaded a bubble around the player instead of the city, and 3D open worlds were never the same. Clip: Mrwhosetheboss. #GTA3 #gamedev #PS2 #Rockstar #leveldesign

clips.title: GTA 6's trailer broke YouTube anyway
clips.caption: 90 videos of GTA 6 leaked in 2022. A year later a 90-second trailer still became the most watched trailer in YouTube history, nearly doubling Avengers Endgame. Clip: Mrwhosetheboss. #GTA6 #Rockstar #gaming

clips.title: What GTA 6's wanted stars actually mean
clips.caption: GTA 6's wanted stars are not a countdown. Solid means they can see you, flashing means they lost you, hollow means they are still guessing, red means you slipped the zone. Clip: Mrwhosetheboss. #GTA6 #gamingtips #Rockstar #openworld
